title: KC Sub-Membrane Ingestion + TypeScript 7 Dashboard POC
outcome: Evolve KC from a context publisher into a read-only estate observer that can correlate governed Sub-Membranes, receipts, capability lanes and unresolved gates without taking orchestration, validation or human action authority.

included: Normalize the 14–17 August 2026 weekend ingestion window while preserving the user's literal range
Seed every GitHub repository discovered in that window as a governed Sub-Membrane descriptor
Preserve canonical authority exclusively in Introduction-to-MCP
Expose KC context-lock, gate, provenance, canonicality, ingestion and frontier-lane state
Create a React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript 7 dashboard POC
Apply design-first-ui-prompting and animation-systems SKILL.md guidance
excluded: Claiming deep semantic ingestion where only discovery/pinning occurred
Giving KC APEX orchestration, KHELOS validation, or human choice authority
Live provider execution, live GitHub polling, deployment, or fabricated realtime receipts
Production write actions from the dashboard

interfaces.name: KC RTCP lineage
interfaces.contract: KC publishes governed context and urgency state as Observer/Landlord; dashboard surfaces that state without expanding authority.

interfaces.name: Sub-Membrane registry
interfaces.contract: Repository logic is seeded by source identity and evidence; no membrane self-canonicalizes.

interfaces.name: Dashboard state
interfaces.contract: Snapshot-first read model with explicit authority and freshness boundaries.

interfaces.name: Skills lineage
interfaces.contract: UI/motion guidance is referenced from RobynAwesome/Skills and remains external/reference material.

interfaces.name: TypeScript stack
interfaces.contract: React 19.2.4 + Vite 8.1.5 + TypeScript 7.0.2 aligned with Kopano-Labs-Website precedent.

constraints: KC may observe, correlate and publish but cannot execute, orchestrate or validate.
Only RobynAwesome/Introduction-to-MCP may be authority=canonical in the registry.
Missing source pins must remain explicit and block semantic promotion.
Dashboard must label snapshot state and cannot imply realtime data without a receipt.
Motion must support prefers-reduced-motion and exist only for hierarchy, feedback or continuity.
Imported skills and external repositories require provenance/license/security/compatibility review before canonical admission.

acceptance_criteria.statement: KC authority is structurally observer-landlord with execute/orchestrate/validate false.
All 13 weekend-discovered repositories are represented exactly once as Sub-Membranes.
Only Introduction-to-MCP is canonical; unpinned membranes remain pending.
Dashboard stack pins TypeScript 7.0.2, React 19.2.4 and Vite 8.1.5.
Dashboard documents and applies design-first and animation-system skill provenance.
Dashboard surfaces context lock, unresolved gates, Sub-Membranes, frontier lanes and authority boundaries.
Dashboard is read-only and does not manufacture APEX/KHELOS/human authority.
Mobile layout and reduced-motion fallback are implemented.
Dependency-free validator checks registry, authority, source pins, dashboard state and TS7 surface.
Realtime/deployed status remains unclaimed until runtime receipts exist.

rollback_plan.trigger: KC gains execution authority, source provenance is ambiguous, registry canonicality drifts, or dashboard claims unproven realtime state.
rollback_plan.procedure: Revert the KC dashboard/Sub-Membrane commit set; no production runtime or provider depends on this POC.
